__broaden__.ni: -(n)i — accusative, marks the object (e.g. ökin-(n)i 'the girl' as object); the Ming writes 行 (case suffix) [女 行] · also on names and on müren (Temüžin-(n)i, De-Sečen-(n)i, müren-(n)i), where the (n) is Shiratori's; in places topic-like, 'as for Temüjin' (Ming 行 or (行)) · also the final -n of the participle -dügsen carried over in print, with Shiratori's (i), the token left before the reflexive -jen (n(i)-jen; participle remnant) [了的]
